categories.main_business_segments: Xiamen Amoytop Biotech Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of recombinant protein and long-acting modified drugs, focusing on immune-related cytokine drugs. Its main product lines include antiviral drugs, notably Pegbina (pegylated interferon alpha-2b) for chronic hepatitis B treatment, and hematology/oncology drugs such as Peijin (long-acting rhG-CSF), Terli (rhGM-CSF), Terjin (rhG-CSF), and Terkang (rhIL-11). The company also operates subsidiaries involved in biotechnology research, health consulting, and medical services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed core platform technologies including PEGylation for long-acting recombinant protein modification, protein drug production using mainstream expression systems (E. coli, yeast, mammalian cells), and drug screening and optimization platforms based on ACTOne Biosensor technology. It has mastered selective modification, site control, and industrial-scale production of PEGylated proteins, enabling improved drug stability, reduced immunogenicity, and extended half-life. The company integrates drug discovery, preclinical and clinical research, production, and marketing into a full-chain innovation system.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are hospitals, medical institutions, and pharmaceutical distributors across China, with a focus on patients suffering from chronic hepatitis B, malignant tumors, and hematological diseases. The company’s products are included in the national medical insurance catalog, enhancing accessibility. Its key markets are domestic, with limited overseas sales, serving clinical treatment needs in viral hepatitis and oncology.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with headquarters and production facilities in Xiamen, Fujian Province. It has a nationwide marketing and distribution network covering major Chinese regions including East China, Central China, Southwest, South China, Northeast, North China, and Northwest. Overseas sales are minimal, accounting for about 0.13% of revenue. The company also holds patents and intellectual property rights in multiple countries including the US, Europe, and Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: Amoytop Biotech operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the biopharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on drug development, manufacturing, and commercialization. It controls the entire process from R&D, production, quality control to marketing and sales, with a robust supply chain management system ensuring raw material procurement and product delivery to medical institutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on innovation in immune and metabolic disease treatments, with a strong emphasis on clinical value and unmet medical needs. It prioritizes R&D in chronic hepatitis B clinical cure, oncology-related hematopoietic growth factors, and metabolic diseases. The company invests heavily in R&D (over 12% of revenue), advances clinical trials for multiple pipeline drugs, and actively pursues external collaborations and licensing agreements to expand its product portfolio and technology platforms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of proprietary biologic drugs, including antiviral and hematology/oncology products. The company also earns income from commercial licensing agreements and technology transfer fees. Sales are conducted mainly via pharmaceutical distributors and direct sales to hospitals, with products included in national and provincial medical insurance reimbursement catalogs, facilitating market penetration.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Amoytop Biotech is a leading domestic innovator in the PEGylated protein long-acting drug segment in China, particularly in hepatitis B treatment and hematopoietic growth factors. It competes with both domestic and international biopharmaceutical companies but has established a strong market position through proprietary technology, patent protection, and inclusion in national insurance catalogs. Its flagship product Pegbina broke foreign monopolies in the Chinese hepatitis B treatment market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.82 billion, a 34.13% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 827.6 million, up 49%. Total assets reached RMB 3.05 billion, growing 29.47%, with net assets of RMB 2.55 billion, up 36.08%. The company maintains a strong growth trajectory supported by expanding product sales, especially Pegbina, and increased R&D investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes clinical value-driven innovation, focusing on long-acting recombinant protein drugs with proprietary PEGylation technology that enhances drug efficacy, safety, and patient compliance. Its flagship product Pegbina offers a dual antiviral and immune modulation mechanism, recognized as a cornerstone in chronic hepatitis B clinical cure. The company’s differentiated product portfolio, supported by extensive patent protection and clinical evidence, provides superior treatment options in viral hepatitis and oncology, addressing unmet clinical needs.
